title: Deployment & integration
subtitle: Desired-vs-real deployments, versions & rollback, governed plan → apply, and the agent→resource wirings that carry them.

sync.pendingHint: Desired state is ahead of what is applied — Plan & Apply to reconcile.
sync.neverAppliedHint: This definition records desired state only — it has not been applied to infrastructure yet.

definitions.name: Deployment
definitions.subject: Subject
definitions.emptyHint: Declare a deployment to record its desired state. Declaring is control-plane only — Plan & Apply reconciles it to infrastructure.

detail.title: Deployment detail
detail.sourceRefHint: GitOps provenance of the desired state, e.g. git:repo#commit.
detail.realStateHint: The applied-state snapshot, present once the deployment has been applied.
detail.envRefsHint: Environment values provided by a secret-store reference — never the value.
detail.wiringsHint: Declared PERMITTED agent→resource connections in this spec.
detail.noSpecHint: The desired spec is not included for this view.
detail.notAppliedHint: This deployment has no real-state snapshot. Plan & Apply to reconcile it to infrastructure.
detail.controlPlaneNote: Declaring, editing and rolling back change desired state only — they never touch running infrastructure. Plan & Apply (a governed, approval-gated action) reconciles the estate.

editor.subjectRefHint: The agent or MCP server this deployment delivers.
editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: A name for this deployment. Unique per environment.
editor.noteHint: Optional note recorded with the new revision.
editor.commandHint: Entrypoint override (non-sensitive — never embed a secret).
editor.envRefsHint: Environment values provided by a secret-store reference (<scheme>:<locator>) — never the value itself.
editor.wiringsHint: Declared PERMITTED agent→resource connections this deployment uses.
editor.secretSchemeHint: Use a <scheme>:<locator> reference (vault, env, file, k8s-secret, …).
editor.credentialWarning: That looks like a credential value. Enter a reference (e.g. vault:secret/data/db#dsn), never the secret itself.
editor.controlPlaneNote: This records desired state only — it does NOT change running infrastructure. Plan & Apply afterwards to reconcile.
editor.confirmCreateBody: Declares the deployment “{{name}}” and its first immutable revision. This records desired state only — it does NOT change running infrastructure.
editor.confirmUpdateBody: Creates a new revision of the desired state for “{{name}}”. It does NOT change running infrastructure — Plan & Apply afterwards to reconcile.

remove.title: Delete deployment definition?
remove.body: Deletes the desired-state record and its wiring declarations for “{{name}}”. Revision and operation history are kept as audit evidence. This does NOT tear down running infrastructure — retire it first if it is still applied (the API rejects with a conflict otherwise).

revisions.title: Versions & rollback
revisions.subtitle: Immutable revision history for “{{name}}”. Each row is a rollback target.
revisions.caption: Rollback is two steps: it declares a NEW desired revision matching the chosen version, then you Plan & Apply (a governed action) to actually restore it.

rollback.title: Roll back desired state?
rollback.body: Rolls the desired state back to version {{version}} by declaring a NEW revision matching it. It does NOT change running infrastructure — you must then Plan & Apply (a governed, approval-gated action) to actually restore it.
rollback.done: Desired state rolled back — Plan & Apply to restore it

plan.title: Run a dry-run plan?
plan.body: Reads infrastructure and computes the diff between desired and real state. It changes nothing on the estate.
plan.noExecutor: Reconciliation is not available — no runtime executor is wired for this deployment yet.

verify.title: Verify against live infrastructure?
verify.body: Reads real state, reports drift and updates the snapshot status. It changes nothing on the estate.

apply.title: Apply to live infrastructure?
apply.body: This is a governed mutation requiring human approval (deny-by-default). Review the planned changes; the approval is bound to this exact plan and is invalidated if the desired spec changes.
apply.planHashNotice: The approval binds to plan {{hash}}. If the spec changes, re-plan.
apply.pendingBody: The apply was requested and is awaiting a governance approval (deny-by-default). It has changed nothing yet.
apply.blockedHint: Governance held this action. The estate was not changed.
apply.noop: Nothing to apply — already up to date.
apply.noExecutor: Reconciliation is not available — no runtime executor is wired for this deployment yet.
apply.retired: This deployment is retired — roll back or edit the desired state before applying.

retire.title: Retire from live infrastructure?
retire.body: High-risk governed mutation requiring human approval (deny-by-default). It tears the deployment down on the estate and revokes its wirings.
retire.edgesNotice: Already-published permitted access edges are NOT auto-retracted — the access map reconciles staleness separately.
retire.pendingBody: The retire was requested and is awaiting a governance approval (deny-by-default). It has changed nothing yet.

gate.approvedHint: Governance approved this plan — execute to proceed.
gate.rejectedHint: Governance rejected this plan — re-request with a fresh plan.
gate.expiredHint: The approval expired — re-plan and request again.
gate.no_gateHint: No approval gate is configured — the action cannot proceed.
gate.not_requiredHint: No approval is required for this action.
gate.displayNotice: Gate status is a reported decision shown here only. Authorization is enforced server-side; the console never grants access from this value.

wirings.title: Permitted agent→resource wirings
wirings.description: The declared PERMITTED connections each agent uses. This is the PERMITTED face the access map contrasts against OBSERVED access.
wirings.emptyHint: Wirings appear here as deployments declare and apply agent→resource connections.
wirings.degradedHint: Per-agent identity could not be firmly bound, so attribution is approximate. This is an honesty signal — not a failure.
wirings.firmHint: Firmly bound to this agent’s identity.
wirings.forbidden: You do not have access to wirings.
wirings.forbiddenHint: Your role can view deployments but not the wiring face. Ask an admin for wiring read access.

operations.title: Change-management ledger
operations.description: An immutable timeline of every plan, apply, verify and retire — who approved what against which plan. Blocked rows are evidence governance held an action.
operations.emptyHint: Every plan, apply, verify and retire is recorded here.

deploy.title: No deployments declared yet
deploy.description: Declare a deployment to record desired state. Reconciling it also needs a runtime executor configured by the operator; without one, Plan and Apply answer 503.

operations.title: No deployment operations recorded yet
operations.description: Plan, Apply, Verify and Retire write a ledger entry only once an operator has configured a runtime executor; until then each answers 503 and records nothing.

wirings.title: No permitted wirings materialized yet
wirings.description: Wirings are declared on a deployment definition and materialize when Apply succeeds, which needs a runtime executor an operator has configured.

truncatedHint: There are more rows than shown; this page takes them by row id (assigned at creation), so the later ones are missing. A definition, wiring or operation NOT listed here is not proof that it does not exist.
